description: Unit test implementation for hashmap data structure, including functions for insertion, retrieval, removal, iteration, and case sensitivity handling.

methods.name: test_entry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for hashmap entries, supports case-insensitive comparison based on ignore_case flag.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value string from a test_entry, which is stored immediately after the key string.

methods.name: alloc_test_entry
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new test_entry with given key and value, computes hash based on case sensitivity.

methods.name: get_test_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a test_entry from the hashmap by key, using hash based on case sensitivity.

methods.name: key_val_contains
methods.description: Checks if a test_entry's key and value match any in a provided key-value array, updates seen array.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a hashmap, runs a test function, then clears and frees the hashmap.

methods.name: t_replace
methods.description: Tests replacing entries in the hashmap with case sensitivity considerations.

methods.name: t_get
methods.description: Tests retrieving entries from the hashmap with case sensitivity considerations.

methods.name: t_add
methods.description: Tests adding entries to the hashmap with case sensitivity considerations.

methods.name: t_remove
methods.description: Tests removing entries from the hashmap with case sensitivity considerations.

methods.name: t_iterate
methods.description: Tests iterating over all entries in the hashmap with case sensitivity considerations.

methods.name: t_alloc
methods.description: Tests bulk insertion and removal, and resizing behavior of the hashmap with case sensitivity considerations.
